item.title: Saimin Rape ~Ore o Kirau Cosplayer ni Osawari Kaihatsu Shite Yatta Ken~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Almond to Kyon Gyuunyuu
  • 発売日: 2021-04-18
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 催眠レイプ～俺を嫌うコスプレイヤーにおさわり開発してやった件～
  • 英語名: Saimin Rape Ore o Kirau Cosplayer ni Osawari Kaihatsu Shite Yatta Ken

あらすじ

The protagonist has a problem;

His favorite cosplayer Momo only has time for big-shot photographers, not a lowlife like him.

However, once he acquires the power of hypnosis…

he’s able to turn her into the obedient sex slave he’s always wanted her to become.

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Almond to Kyon Gyuunyuu
  • 発売日: 2021-01-09
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: ゲームの世界にバケモノとして転生した件につきまして。
  • 英語名: Game no Sekai ni Bakemono to Shite Tensei Shita Ken ni Tsukimashite.

あらすじ

The only thing that washes away the daily stress of your factory job is that of MMORPGs.

Taking control of that carefully-sculpted and ideal girl fills you with life.

While playing the game…you fall asleep, and suddenly awaken in the starter dungeon!

And you’re a tentacle monster!

item.description:

  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 人気コスプレイヤーの姉を調教配信してみた
  • 英語名: Ninki Cosplayer no Ane o Choukyou Haishin Shite Mita

あらすじ

A little brother living together with his big sister is distraught when he finds out

his cosplaying big sister has been propositioned by a famous cameraman.

Afraid that she’ll be stolen away from him, he decides to do some filming of his own,

and sexually train her via live-stream. He binds her up, and gets to work…
